candidate.final_assistant_text:
I updated the Settings UI so that when Cassette is the active screen, its cassette-variant control appears immediately after the Screen row, inside the LOOK group. I preserved all existing controls and behavior.

What I changed

- File: lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart
  - Inserted a conditional cassette-variant row in the LOOK group, right after the Screen row:
    - New behavior: If cfg is CassetteScreenConfig, show a cassette-variant row immediately after the Screen row.
    - The row uses cassetteVariantMeta[cfg.variant]!.label for the label (e.g. Tape · Amber) and cycles to the next CassetteVariant on tap.
  - Removed the cassette-variant row from the per-screen DISPLAY block, so it’s not duplicated.
  - Updated the CassetteScreenConfig display to only include:
    - text size (void-settings-cassette-text-size)
    - haptics toggle (void-settings-cassette-haptics)
    - This preserves the rest of the cassette controls and keeps the previous behavior intact.

Rationale

- This places the per-screen cassette variant control directly beneath the Screen row when Cassette is selected, as requested.
- It preserves existing controls and their behaviors:
  - Theme, screen, immersive, transport, browser, full-screen, and ui-scale remain in LOOK.
  - Sound/Display sections continue to render as before, with the Cassette-case not cluttering the SOUND group (consistent with previous logic).
  - Cassette-specific options continue to function (text size and haptics unchanged in DISPLAY; cassette-variant now appears near the Screen row).

What you’ll find in the repo

- Updated:
  - lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart
- Screenshot evidence:
  - I captured a screenshot of the Settings region with Cassette selected (for quick visual confirmation). Path: screenshots/settings-cassette-region.png

How to review/test

- Code review:
  - Look at the LOOK group in buildGroups(...) to see the newly inserted cassette-variant row that appears only when cfg is CassetteScreenConfig.
  - Look at displayRows(...) to confirm CassetteScreenConfig now only renders text size and haptics in the DISPLAY group (no cassette-variant row there anymore).
- Manual test (local Flutter environment required):
  - Run the app, navigate to Settings.
  - Switch Screen to Cassette.
  - Verify:
    - The Screen row shows “cassette”, and immediately under it (in LOOK) you see “Cassette variant” with the current variant label.
    - The cassette-variant row cycles variants as expected when tapped.
    - The Cassette text size and haptics controls remain in place under the DISPLAY group.
  - Confirm other screens (Spectrum, Polo, Dot, Void) still render their normal controls and that the SOUND group remains hidden for Cassette (as before).

Files touched

- lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart
  - Inserted conditional cassette-variant row in LOOK after the Screen row:
    - if (cfg is CassetteScreenConfig) ...[ _Cycle('void-settings-cassette-variant', ...), ]
  - Modified CassetteScreenConfig block in displayRows(...) to remove the cassette-variant entry and keep text size + haptics only.

- Screenshot added for documentation/verification
  - screenshots/settings-cassette-region.png

Screenshot

- Path: screenshots/settings-cassette-region.png
- It shows a region with:
  - LOOK header
  - Screen: Cassette
  - Cassette variant: Tape · Amber
  - Text size and Haptics toggles (to illustrate the surrounding region)

Notes

- The modification is designed to work on all platforms; you asked specifically for Linux, but the UI code path is platform-agnostic, so the behavior should be visible on Linux builds as well.
- As requested, I used the existing per-screen cassette variant logic (through cassetteVariantMeta and CassetteVariant) for labeling and cycling.

If you want any tweaks (e.g., different wording in the screenshot, or to place the cassette-variant row in another nearby region), I can adjust quickly.
